name: Customer quotation
gate: Use the immutable submitted Quote snapshot. Customer prices only; never expose buying prices.

name: Freight invoice
gate: Finance-issued invoice identity, tax and totals only. No invoice numbering or financial recalculation in the template.

name: Freight proforma invoice
gate: Finance proforma projection only. This is not a posted tax invoice.

name: Advice of charges
gate: Approved customer-facing Finance lines only; exclude cost and internal notes.

name: Remittance advice
gate: Do not treat a requisition or advice as proof of payment; use only recorded Finance payment facts.

name: Arrival notice
gate: Recorded arrival and availability only. An arrival notice is not release authority.

name: Customs clearance instructions
gate: Customer-supplied source data for the Customs team, not a Customs declaration or clearance result.

name: Delivery confirmation
gate: Confirm delivery only from a recorded actual event and evidence; do not manufacture a signature.

name: ERTS release request
gate: Request layout only. An authorised release-note workflow and verified clearance are needed before issuing any release authority.

name: Container PIN request
gate: Request only; never invent a PIN, Customs release or carrier permission.

name: Cargo release request
gate: Does not replace an authorised Release Order. Use a separate verified approval path for release authority.

name: Transport instructions
gate: Collection and delivery locations must be explicitly recorded. Never substitute party addresses automatically.

name: Sea booking request
gate: Request, not a carrier confirmation. Retain unknown booking numbers, schedules and weights as unknown.

name: Shipping instructions
gate: Separate master and house parties, marks, equipment and cargo allocations. Instructions are not an issued bill.

name: Bill of lading instructions
gate: Only instruct the authorised issuer. Do not replicate carrier terms, title documents or FIATA security forms.

name: Standard shipping note
gate: Operational draft, not an approved SITPRO form. Confirm destination requirements before use.

name: Road consignment instructions
gate: Draft instructions only, not a CMR or US legal Bill of Lading. Approved terms and required form are a later review gate.

name: Road and courier cargo label
gate: A4 layout draft; agree printer dimensions and identifiers before label generation. No invented carrier barcode.

name: Courier docket
gate: Recorded courier movement only; no inferred delivery or recipient signature.

name: Collection and delivery note
gate: Keep planned and actual movement separate. Leave signatures for authorised human completion.

name: Air assembly manifest
gate: Consolidation membership and source line values only. No inferred security clearance or airline rates.

name: Sea assembly manifest
gate: One authorised consolidation dataset; avoid duplicate master and house cargo totals.

name: Consolidation manifest
gate: Address/detail/name-only views share one layout family. Approved projection decides columns and party visibility.

name: Agent manifest
gate: Agent-facing approved data only; exclude internal prices and confidential unrelated consignments.

name: Customs manifest source sheet
gate: Handoff source sheet, not a government-issued manifest or submitted declaration.

name: Container loading manifest
gate: Use saved cargo-to-container allocations, including split quantities. Never calculate VGM from cargo weight.

name: Packing list
gate: Jenkar-prepared draft only. Do not replace a customer-issued original required as Customs evidence.

name: Commercial invoice working draft
gate: Customer approval and authoritative trade values required. Not a Jenkar freight invoice, original customer invoice or CARICOM-certified form.

name: Warehouse goods in note
gate: Warehouse receipt records only; not a FIATA FCR or ownership certificate.

name: Warehouse goods out note
gate: Confirmed dispatch quantities only, preserving inventory and permissions.

name: Warehouse pick list
gate: Saved order and location allocation only; a pick list is not confirmation of dispatch.

name: Warehouse inventory report
gate: Authorised point-in-time stock projection; define zero-stock filtering before wiring.

name: Operational job sheet
gate: Internal operations only; master job detail must not double count house cargo or reveal unrelated records.

name: Pre shipment advice
gate: Planned dates clearly labelled; no implied departure, release or delivery.

name: Vehicle handover record
gate: Additional sample-derived layout. Preserve each VIN/chassis, vehicle condition and mileage; no inferred ownership or signature.
